# Students and Mentorship

```{r mentorship-setup, include=FALSE}
library(lubridate)
library(glue)
.mentorship <- vroom::vroom("data/mentorship.csv") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), trimws)) %>%
  mutate(
    when       = fmt_dates_text(when),
    start_date = parse_month(when),
    is_active = grepl("Present", when)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(is_active), start_date)
```

## Advisees

```{r advisees}
.mentorship %>%
  filter(position %in% c("Advisor", "Co-Advisor")) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(
    what = glue("{who}, {position} ({degree}, {where})"),
    when = when
  )
```

## Committee Roles

```{r committee}
.mentorship %>%
  filter(!position %in% c("Advisor", "Co-Advisor")) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(
    what = glue("{who}, {position} ({degree}, {where})"),
    when = when
  )
```

## BSS Scholars

Year-long undergraduate research program of the Biodesign Center for Biocomputing, Security and Society, ASU.\
Olivia Smith (PhD student) serves as graduate mentor across all projects.

```{r bss-scholars}
# One header row per project (title + mentor), then one row per scholar.
# Projects I mentor directly come first; scholars are listed active-first.
.bss <- vroom::vroom("data/bss-scholars.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    across(everything(), ~ replace_na(trimws(as.character(.x)), "")),
    when       = fmt_dates_text(when),
    start_date = parse_month(when),
    is_active = grepl("Present", when),
    direct    = mentor == ""
  )

.bss_projects <- .bss %>%
  group_by(project, mentor, mentor_role, direct) %>%
  summarize(first_start = min(start_date), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(direct), first_start) %>%
  mutate(order = row_number())

bind_rows(
  .bss_projects %>%
    transmute(
      order, row = 0L, project,
      what = if_else(direct, "Mentored directly", glue("Mentor: {mentor} ({mentor_role})")),
      when = ""
    ),
  .bss %>%
    inner_join(select(.bss_projects, project, order), by = "project") %>%
    arrange(order, desc(is_active), start_date) %>%
    group_by(order) %>%
    mutate(row = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(order, row, project = "", what = scholar, when)
) %>%
  arrange(order, row) %>%
  # Escape by hand so the project title can be set in upright-weight italics
  mutate(
    across(c(what, when, project), ~ gsub("([$&%#_])", "\\\\\\1", .x)),
    project = if_else(project != "", glue("\\textmd{{\\textit{{{project}}}}}"), project)
  ) %>%
  vitae::detailed_entries(what = what, when = when, with = project, .protect = FALSE)
```
